title: When the tongue keeps outrunning the soul
issueStatement: Words are arriving faster than the heart has been cleansed enough to carry them, so speech starts leaving damage before wisdom has entered the room.
centralInsight: Gurbani disciplines speech through remembrance, humility, and praise. The tongue becomes trustworthy when it no longer serves ego, impulse, or spiritual theatre.
practicalReflection: Speech reveals the inner climate quickly. A mouth that cannot slow down is often showing a heart that has not yet become quiet enough to tell the truth well.
actionPrompt: Before the next unnecessary word, ask whether it will leave the room cleaner or more scattered.
